text.en:
The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the
Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the purchase of primary textbooks for use in the public
schools under the jurisdiction of the Bureau of Education. This sum shall be in addition to any amount that
may be spent for the same purpose from the appropriation for the Bureau of Education for the fiscal year
nineteen hundred and thirty-seven.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nine-teen hundred and thirty-seven.
Approved, November 3, 1936.
